横条是普通的不透明 / 半透明浮层：不抓屏、不跑 WebGL、不对抓屏隐身，截图: The bar is a plain opaque / translucent overlay: it never captures the screen, never runs WebGL and is never hidden from screen capture — screenshots and recordings pick it up normally. Its colour follows “Interface theme”, and the tint is controlled by “Bar opacity”.
